The ordering regression now checks import-edge tuple order for traversal and caller-supplied sort-key strategies, not only module order.
limitations: This observation records the failing regression before the explicit-stack repair. It makes no GREEN, package, corpus, or completion claim.

summary: Expose the host-recursion defect and missing edge-order assertions.
